questions.explanation: A past form is needed in a reduced relative clause: 'the menu you requested last week'.

choices: Our restaurant is closed on Mondays.
The quote includes service, tableware, and setup.
Parking is available behind the theater.
Our chef will teach a cooking class in June.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains the quote, which precedes the information about payment.
'On the day of' is the standard expression.
The call is requested on condition that the customer wants a change.
